variants.name: Profile
variants.summary: The Profile and bio tab: personal information, contact and links, and contribution visibility.

variants.name: Security
variants.summary: The Security and access tab for an account that signs in with a password: password fields with live requirements, multi-factor and personal tokens.

variants.name: SecuritySso
variants.summary: The Security and access tab when the organization's SSO and SCIM provider manages the password and requires multi-factor: the controls are locked and say why.

variants.name: Notifications
variants.summary: The Notifications tab: the notification email, the three scheduled digests and the real-time alerts.

variants.name: Preferences
variants.summary: The Preferences tab: theme and the Keyboard shortcuts switch that hides every shortcut hint when off.

variants.name: Empty
variants.summary: A new user with no contributions yet: zero metrics, an empty graph and an EmptyState in place of the history.

variants.name: Loading
variants.summary: The first load: Skeletons in the header, the metrics, the graph and the history.

variants.name: Error
variants.summary: The profile failed to load: a danger Alert with Retry replaces the page.
